name: Quantum Chemistry and Spectroscopy
description: Basic concepts and postulates of quantum mechanics. Simple systems (particle in a box, harmonic oscillator) hydrogen atom. Many electron atoms. Variation theorem. Perturbation theory. Molecular orbital and valence bond theories. Fundamentals of electronic, vibrational and rotational spectroscopy.
